steps.text: Authoritative current-state read — from Shopify, this session, not from a prompt, a prior report, or a document in this repo.
Target identity verification — the GID you are about to write to is the GID you read back, checked field by field, not matched by name or by position.
Concurrency snapshot — capture the fields the write must not disturb, so collateral damage is detectable afterwards.
Smallest mutation that achieves the goal.
Independent fresh read, issued after the mutation returned.
Exact comparison on the intended field.
Comparison on unrelated state that must not have moved.
`updatedAt` check wherever the resource carries one.
Only then classify the mutation as successful.
Re-verify the target theme's `role` immediately before the write. Role can change between your first read and your write — that is exactly what happened on 2026-08-21.
Re-verify the product's `status` immediately before the write.
